decisions.reason: As a flagship line close to the firm’s core glass-packaging capabilities and still present a year after launch in a growing, R&D-intensive firm, it remains a relatively low-cost strategic option whose upside has not been disproven.

Because it was just launched in 2024 as a dedicated flagship technology built directly on established processing know-how, uncertainty is still high but favorable and the option value of keeping it clearly exceeds near-term carrying costs.
